data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported prior year reserve releases of $33.9m in 2014 (2013: $49.7m), driven by generally favourable claims development and a relatively benign catastrophe year (only a small exposure to Hurricane Odile). Releases were recorded across divisions (notably Marine, Property, Reinsurance, Specialty and Political risks & contingency) and the level of releases in 2014 was closer to the five-year average rather than the exceptional 2013 releases.
raw_causal_phrases: During 2014, we have been able to release prior year reserves of $33.9m (2013: $49.7m).

Overall, the claims environment has been favourable during 2014. There has been little natural catastrophe activity during the year, with a small exposure to Hurricane Odile seen on the property book.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development amount (-33.9) taken from the managing agent narrative stating 'release prior year reserves of $33.9m'. The report does not present an explicit separate gross 'movement in prior year provision' line by insurance liabilities in the technical reserves reconciliation; therefore this narrative figure is used as the gross prior year movement. If interpreted as net of reinsurance the gross figure is not separately shown. All monetary amounts are in the report's functional currency (USD). Mapping of some divisional LOB names to the standardized Lloyd's LOB list is approximate where no exact match existed (e.g. 'Political risks and contingency' mapped to 'Casualty').

_claims_triangle.note: A gross claims development table (percentages and amounts) is present in the Technical Provisions note (pages ~41-44). Detailed development-period numeric rows (At end of UW year, One year later, etc.) were not extracted into this JSON. The report contains both percentage development and ultimate loss amounts; extracting the full numeric development triangle would require reconstructing cumulative amounts from the table and was not performed here.
